# SaviorBill

> Self-hosted billing platform with Lua 5.4 extensions, modern Admin UI, and automated client onboarding.

## Documentation
- [Quickstart & Installation](https://saviorbill.com/docs/quickstart/): Fast installation and Docker deployment
- [Lua API Reference](https://saviorbill.com/docs/lua-api/): Lua 5.4 sandbox context, crypto, and Redis cache methods
- [Manifest Schema](https://saviorbill.com/docs/lua-manifest/): Extension manifest JSON schema and fields
- [Lua Contracts](https://saviorbill.com/docs/lua-contracts/): Payment gateways, service provisioners, and event triggers
- [sbuiSDK Components](https://saviorbill.com/docs/sbuisdk-components/): Server-Driven UI components for customer storefronts
- [Extensions Hub](https://saviorbill.com/hub/): Ready-to-use Lua extensions for Marzban, YooKassa, CryptoBot

## Optional
- [Releases & Container Builds](https://saviorbill.com/releases/): GitHub releases, changelogs, and GHCR container tags for all ecosystem repositories
- [Blog](https://saviorbill.com/blog/): Tutorials and architecture articles
- [Blog RSS (RU)](https://saviorbill.com/rss.xml): RSS 2.0 feed for Russian blog articles
- [Blog RSS (EN)](https://saviorbill.com/en/rss.xml): RSS 2.0 feed for English blog articles
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/UNVISLATE/SaviorBill): Source code and issue tracker
